# Corvus repository metadata

## Repository name

`corvus`

## GitHub About description

High-performance WebGPU node editor for browser applications. Developed by Raykast.

## Longer description

Corvus is an open-source node editor that renders graph cards, ports,
connections, labels, selection, and live previews in one WebGPU canvas. A
dedicated worker handles deterministic layout and scene packing, while the host
keeps full ownership of graph state. Corvus is developed by
[Raykast](https://raykast.com/).

## Release summary

The first Corvus release provides a dependency-free browser package, a scoped
default theme, a ProFont GPU atlas, application-owned editing callbacks,
dockable workspace panels, headless graph utilities, and a complete runnable
example.
